userMessage.content: Create a one-shot TypeScript script that announces zombies are incoming, reads the configured demo location with host.server.status(), spawns exactly three ZOMBIE entities nearby, and sends a private confirmation to GoldennBullet. Use only the registered Host SDK. Read status first, then use Promise.all for the broadcast, three spawns and private message so it fits the ten-second budget. Print the typed results as JSON, including an offline-player failure. Propose narrow constraints and explain that I must review permissions and separately click Run. Do not claim any capability is approved.
